This past weekend, the film overtook John Wick 3’s lifetime global haul of $327 million to become the series’ biggest film. The only major box office record left for it to break is the third film’s $171 million lifetime domestic haul, which it should pass by the end of its run. John Wick 4 made nearly $74 million in its domestic opening weekend, and despite a considerable 62% drop in weekend two, it went on to surpass the lifetime hauls of each of its predecessors. The first to fall was the first John Wick, of course. Released nearly a decade ago in 2014, the first film was a much leaner beast; it ended its run with $86 million worldwide against a reported budget of $20 million.
